name: nemzeti-vpn-tv
description: An independent NVT live TV client for LG webOS

scripts.package:tv: npm run build && ares-package dist/tv dist/service -o dist/packages
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:ui
scripts.package:cx: npm run build:cx && ares-package dist/cx/tv dist/cx/service -o dist/cx/packages
scripts.test:ui:cx: npm run build:cx && playwright test --config playwright.cx.config.cjs
